assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production asset: a transparent 4 by 4 atlas of SIXTEEN separate tiny European football-club cartoon illustrations for a football management game named Stadium Green. These must be charming richly hand drawn European sports-comic illustrations, opaque gouache color, clean dark evergreen ink outline, warm cream highlights, slight three-quarter volume, restrained vintage football annual illustration aesthetic. NOT Lucide, NOT thin line web UI glyphs, NOT flat generic app icons. Each pictogram has an independent complete silhouette, generous transparent margins within its own equal square cell. Consistent optical size and strong recognition at 28 pixels. Exact row-major subjects: row 1 a little football clubhouse, a league standings board, a golden cup trophy, a history scrapbook with clock; row 2 two football players, training cones and football, a club office building, a leather football boot; row 3 a cheering scarf-carrying crowd, a coach in tracksuit, a green football shirt, a brass notification bell; row 4 three stacked ticket strips suggesting menu, two curved transfer arrows, a filled playful play triangle, a bright warm heart. Deep green, grass greens, golden ochre, cream, touches of coral. No words, numbers, letters, labels, grid lines, surrounding squares, contact shadows beyond each silhouette, watermark. Actual alpha transparent background everywhere between objects. All sixteen cells fully separated, no objects crossing cell edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI asset atlas, NOT a mockup: a 4 by 4 grid of sixteen separate blank handmade clay sticker component plates, isolated on a truly transparent background. Smooth matte polymer clay, adorable softly rounded inflated edges and soft cream sticker rim, dark forest-green thin contour, subtle molded relief, very gentle soft shadow, clean untextured faces. No rough paper, grain, scratches, hatching, burlap or grunge. Every cell is same size with large transparent gutters and complete silhouette. All frames should be square with straight stretchable centers and fixed rounded corners for nine-slice rendering; no chamfered/cut lower corners, no zigzags. Exact row-major content: row1 sunny buttery yellow primary square plate, pale sage secondary square plate, warm ivory tertiary square plate, pale ivory recessed input square plate. Row2 forest green dark square plate, ivory selected square plate with yellow inner rim, pale warm grey disabled square plate, rounded ivory popup square plate. Row3 empty cream rounded checkbox, same checkbox with dark green clay check mark, a round golden-yellow formation disc with cream rim, a short thin smooth green horizontal clay divider. Row4 five-tier-rating preview irrelevant: instead four smooth blank square mini plates in copper bronze, pale cool silver, warm yellow gold, icy cyan platinum. Important all faces blank no text no lettering no baked labels, no numbers, no symbols except checkmark in cell row3 col2. Consistent top-down orthographic view, no perspective. Frames must have uninterrupted solid edge geometry, with no overlapping seams.

Clean and cute, not distressed, not paper, no fibers, no scratches, no specks, no grain noise, no diagonal bands, no hatching, no repeating chevrons. Clearly different brightness levels between cream materials, yellow vibrant but gentle.
